input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，The place phrase should come before the verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 does not naturally introduce the action of performing a ritual; 假装 means “pretend to do” and can be followed by an action. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 五岁的时候：五岁的时候，The structure ……的时候 requires 的 after a multi-syllable phrase. [teacher rule: de_shihou]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友喜欢在墓地里玩：他和朋友喜欢在墓地里玩，Use a pronoun for a recently mentioned character when no competing referent has appeared. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is a completed move at a specific age, so the completed action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不自然，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达假扮进行祭拜。
“五岁的时候”本来就有“的”，结构正确，系统也没有作出任何改动。
前一句刚提到孟子，按教师的指代规则，此处应用“他”而不必重复名字。
五岁时搬家是叙事中的已完成事件，应说“搬了家”。
